## About
Champ Automotive Services is an independent repair shop at 5040 Umbria St in Philadelphia, proudly serving Roxborough and Whitemarsh Township. Our mechanics are specialized in Volkswagen and Audi repair, and we service foreign and domestic cars, trucks and SUVs.
You can get the repair your vehicle needs without overpaying. Customers mention Sean by name in their reviews. One said he "never dummy downed his explanation" and let her know what could wait. Another said he recommends work "without forcing any unnecessary services."
We're rated 4.9 on Google from 61 reviews. Come by the shop or give us a call.

## Services
- Brake Service: Complete brake repair and maintenance for foreign or domestic vehicles: brake fluid, brake cylinders, power brake booster, drum brakes, disc brakes and ABS sensors.
- FREE brake inspection: Squeaky brakes? Call and set up a free brake inspection.
- PA State Inspection: State inspections for your car, done right here at the shop.
- Volkswagen and Audi repair: Our mechanics specialize in Volkswagen and Audi, from small repairs to large ones.
- Large and small repairs: Large repairs or small, we have the training and equipment to fix them the first time.
- Emergency towing: Emergency towing is available around the clock.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Volkswagen and Audi?
A: No. We specialize in Volkswagen and Audi repair, but we service foreign and domestic cars, trucks and SUVs as well.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes, night drop is available.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're on Umbria St in Philadelphia and proudly serve Roxborough and Whitemarsh Township.
